description:
Halloween: The Game brings Michael Myers to PS5 in IllFonic's asymmetric horror take on John Carpenter's slasher legend. This playthrough covers the full single-player campaign start to finish — a faithful love letter to the 1978 original with strong voice performances, held back by janky gameplay moments and framerate hiccups on launch hardware.

Developer: IllFonic
Publisher: IllFonic Publishing (with Gun Interactive)
Release Date: September 8, 2026
Platforms: PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC

MWG Verdict: Single-player is very true to the 1978 Halloween film with good performances — but janky gameplay and framerate problems hold it back. Needed a longer development cycle.

Halloween: The Game is developed by IllFonic (Friday the 13th: The Game, Predator: Hunting Grounds, Ghostbusters: Spirits Unleashed) and self-published under IllFonic Publishing with Gun Interactive as co-publisher. Set in the world of John Carpenter's 1978 Halloween, the game leans into the asymmetric horror formula IllFonic built its reputation on — one player takes on the role of Michael Myers stalking survivors around Haddonfield, Illinois. John Carpenter is attached to the project, with franchise producer Malek Akkad involved on the production side. Alongside the multiplayer mode, the release ships with a single-player experience that plays through story beats faithful to the source film.
